channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Ad blitz targets BCBS amid Jackson Hospital lawsuit
item.description: A newly formed group is spending heavily on TV ads as Jackson Hospital’s bankruptcy and lawsuit against Blue Cross move forward.

item.title: Gov. Ivey announces $43.8 million in low-income heating and cooling grants
item.description: The funds, secured through ADECA and federal acts, addressed challenges facing vulnerable Alabamians needing help covering heating and cooling costs during extreme weather.

item.title: Bill would bar governments from using “West Bank” as term for Israel region
item.description: A state representative prefiled legislation requiring government entities to use "Judea and Samaria" for the region, claiming "West Bank" erases Jewish identity.

item.title: Prefiled bill would redefine crime of “making a terrorist threat,” raise penalties
item.description: State senators prefiled SB31 for the 2026 session, redefining the crime and significantly increasing maximum prison sentences and mandatory fines for conviction.

item.title: Opinion | What would Jesus think of our politics and our treatment of neighbors?
item.description: A Christmas reflection asking whether faith, mercy and love of neighbor still guide our public life today in American politics.

item.title: Alabama parole grant rate remains low in November report
item.description: Parole grant rates for the fiscal year 2026 sit at 17 percent, compared to 29 percent in November 2024.

item.title: Proposed legislation would require parole board to weigh rehabilitation
item.description: HB86 would require Alabama’s parole board to positively consider rehabilitation, low recidivism risk, work and education when reviewing parole decisions.

item.title: Alabama settles lawsuit over institutionalizing disabled children
item.description: A preliminary settlement required Alabama to institute standardized assessments and shift children from rigid facilities into community-based care.

item.title: Ron Sparks considering comeback bid amid concerns for Alabama farmers
item.description: Ron Sparks is weighing a return to state office, saying farmers, consumers and food security need stronger leadership and renewed policy focus.

item.title: Rep. Ensler says he would push for gambling legislation as lieutenant governor
item.description: Alabama politicians need to “focus on the things that are gonna improve people’s quality of life,” Ensler said.
